text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship goes head-to-head with Nakayama Festa to get one step closer to her dreams' true meaning and to the ultimate goal of Eden.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: First off is a spicy showdown, to fuel those bile tanks! Next is an abdominal affray that'd make anyone hurl—one hundred sit-ups in a minute! Somehow, both contestants pull through.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look on as the competition ends in a literal stand-off to see who can be the best mall mannequin. Being scrutinized by the public proves too much for Nakayama Festa, and Gold Ship claims victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back, Gold Ship tells me about the voice in her dreams telling her to go to Eden.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Could her dreams really be connected to Eden? Gold Ship takes off in an all-out sprint, leaving me lost in thought.
